blocks.text: The 2026 Miss Grand International pageant has not concluded yet, but the organizers are already gearing up for the 15 edition happening next year, with Thailand as the host country yet again. Reigning queen Emma Tiglao made the announcement during the pre-final swimsuit competition of this year’s pageant held at Lebua State Tower in Bangkok on Tuesday morning, Sept. 29.
